summary: CaptionIQ Studio — full E2E test run on live preview URL (test@captioniq.com / Test1234!, project proj_6c6b9acc73c6). All 10 review-request feature tests PASSED. bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: Copy is not defined — 'Copy' icon from lucide-react used in ProjectCard JSX but not imported. Caused full dashboard ProjectCard render crash when user had projects.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added 'Copy' to the lucide-react import list. Also added missing 'onClone' to ProjectCard destructured props (it was already passed at the call site via onClone={handleClone}).

rca_of_issue: Dashboard.jsx imported lucide-react icons without including 'Copy'. When ProjectCard rendered, it evaluated the JSX expression '<Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />' which threw 'ReferenceError: Copy is not defined' at bundle.js:11398:97 crashing the entire ProjectCard tree. This also prevented the 'New Project' button from rendering. Fix: add Copy to the import statement and onClone to ProjectCard destructured props.
